conductivity_mS_per_m.note: Month labels are aggregates of supplied samples, not continuous monthly salinity. Actual publication dates unavailable; month-end is a declared retrospective assumption.

precipitation_sum.note: Monthly sum of daily precipitation. API documentation supports mm, but original request/response metadata and revision vintages are not retained.

temperature_mean.note: Air temperature at 2m, mean of daily means; not water temperature for EC conversion.

evapotranspiration_sum.note: Sum of daily reference ET0; not measured river evaporation.

water_level_m.note: DAHITI regional label; not proven co-located with MRC or gate. Thirty days is an assumption, not an established source release schedule.

glofas_discharge_m3s.note: Legacy spatial mean over the supplied GloFAS grid; not certified discharge at Tan Chau. Thirty days is an assumption.

weather_availability_note: Five days chosen as an experimental release-delay scenario consistent with documented ERA5/ERA5-Land latency; historical CSV model choice/timezone/request metadata are not independently confirmed.

metadata_findings.mrc_csv_readme_xlsx: No explicit source-series EC temperature compensation declaration found. The shared strings and document metadata of both XLSX exports were additionally searched.
metadata_findings.weather_daily_to_monthly: Both source CSVs have 15218 unique daily records, 1985-01-01 through 2026-08-31. All 500 months complete. Three selected weather columns reproduce the master within floating point precision.
